name: Shrinking Header with Shadow
description: A profile style header that compresses and gains a drop shadow over the first 150px of scroll, scrubbed by animation-timeline: scroll() with a short animation-range. Pure CSS, fully reversible, degrades to a plain sticky header.
usage: Include styles.css, place the .shh-header block as the first element of <body> with your <main> as its direct sibling (it receives the margin compensation when the header goes fixed), then swap in your own name, meta list and avatar. Tune --shh-distance, --shh-height and --shh-height-min on :root to change the feel.
